title: More shaded waiting areas near schools
description: Plant shade trees and add covered waiting areas along busy school routes so students, commuters, and parents can wait more safely and comfortably.

title: Safer pedestrian crossings near public markets
description: Improve crosswalk markings, lighting, and pedestrian visibility near busy market approaches.

title: More trees and pocket parks
description: Identify small public spaces where additional trees, seating, and low-maintenance greenery could benefit nearby residents.

title: Public bike racks near civic destinations
description: Install secure bicycle parking near public offices, schools, markets, and other frequently visited destinations.

title: Improve accessibility at public facilities
description: Make entrances, paths, signs, and waiting areas easier to use for senior citizens and persons with disabilities.

title: Weekend community markets
description: Create regular weekend spaces where local growers, makers, and small businesses can meet residents.

title: Additional public trash bins
description: Place clearly labeled waste bins at busy pedestrian areas and provide a simple collection and maintenance plan.

title: Public Wi-Fi zones in community spaces
description: Explore reliable, time-limited public internet access in selected libraries, plazas, and other community spaces.
